body:
Two-Faced Betel
I sought out this experience after hearing about Betel's widespread use in Asia. It's chewed for a stimulant effect as recreation but it also has some relaxing properties. I was anxious about it's potential cancer-causing effects so I hesitated for a few days before heading out to an asian market to buy some. Keep in mind you also have to buy slaked lime and betel leaf if you want a more traditional experience.
T-20::::::: I bought dry whole nut and tried to chop it. It took 10 minutes before I realized I needed to grate it. I made only a quarter nut because they use only a little in the thai video I saw-- as opposed to eating a whole fresh nut like they do in other countries.
After grating I added a bit of water to make a small puddle and added a small dab of slaked lime like 1/8 teaspoon (probably too much) and mixed it up to dissolve the lime.
T-10::::::: After a few minutes of stirring some more I let it sit for about 5 mins.
T+0::::::::: I decided to drink it when I noticed the solid chunks of nut had definitively reacted, turned black, and sunk to the bottom. I could see the various compounds forming an oily film on the surface.
T+5::::::: I can already tell something is going on. I'm hungry and worried about the chunks of colon cancer I just drank and decide to go to the supermarket.
T+10::::: Wow betel is SOOOO relaxing. It feels like a wave of warmth and peace enveloping me. No kidding. I can feel the everlasting warmth tugging on me to plop down on this Philippine resort. With the way I prepared it its mostly relaxing instead of stimulating. I didn't feel any overwhelming stimulation except for a buzz.
T+20:::::: The supermarket which is usually cold and uncomfortable was really fun but alas I don't even remember much because I felt on cloud 9 the whole time.
T+60::::::  On my way back I also got a joint and smoked, by now betel had mostly peaked and I felt in the same sea of tranquility as when it first came up. Smoking was fun but the calmness of the betel really overpowered the weed. I still felt high but was feeling deep body load and a stillness which made it hard to feel the weed much I just felt so tranquil and buttery smooth.
It is really enjoyable and smooth. I could only imagine what this would be like at an actual Philippine spa. The only sad part is the cancer causing compounds in the nut. Much more research is needed and its sad to see it's still not available as a pure pharmaceutical product. It is very very similar to gabapentin in feeling.
